description: This is the protein ID for one representative protein per gene.
This lists InterProScan member database accessions like Pfam:PF00005 separated by semicolons.
This lists the text description for each InterProScan domain in the same order.
This lists the InterPro accessions like IPR000001 from InterProScan.
This lists InterProScan GO IDs which are IEA electronic inferences that no person checked.
This is the orthologous group at the annotation level representing an orthology call from eggNOG-mapper.
This is the preferred name assigned by eggNOG-mapper.
This is the description text assigned by eggNOG-mapper.
This lists eggNOG-mapper GO IDs which are IEA electronic inferences that no person checked.
This lists reported KEGG KO IDs from eggNOG-mapper but this is never the final KO.
This shows swissprot, trembl or empty for the DIAMOND database hit.
This is the DIAMOND subject ID but remember a homology hit does not prove function.
This is the protein name taken from the DIAMOND hit title.
This is the DIAMOND e value where the threshold is a rule of thumb so compare the numbers with a close relative species annotated the same way.
This is the DIAMOND percent identity where the threshold is a rule of thumb so compare the numbers with a close relative species annotated the same way.
This is the DIAMOND query coverage where the threshold is a rule of thumb so compare the numbers with a close relative species annotated the same way.
This is the DIAMOND subject coverage where the threshold is a rule of thumb so compare the numbers with a close relative species annotated the same way.
This lists the final KEGG KO IDs from KofamScan rows that pass the KO threshold.
This is the gene name: a passing Swiss-Prot name, else eggNOG "similar to X", else an InterProScan domain name, else "uncharacterized protein".
This records the final name source as swissprot or eggnog or interproscan_domain or none.
This lists sorted GO terms which are IEA electronic inferences that no person checked.
This says IEA whenever go_terms is not empty, because GO terms here are electronic inferences that no person checked.
This lists which tools gave each GO term like GO:0016491=interproscan,eggnog.
This records the exact tool versions and dates like interproscan=5.72-103.0@2026-09-01.
